description: This is a PHP source file defining a class named 'Controller' that extends 'SugarBean'. It contains methods for managing ordered components within a CRM system, including initializing, changing component order, updating affected items, checking boundary constraints, and adjusting order after deletions.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: A class for managing ordered components within a CRM system, extending SugarBean and providing functionality for component reordering, boundary checking, and deletion adjustment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Controller object and disables row-level security.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a seed object and a type identifier.

methods.name: change_component_order
methods.description: Changes the order of a component (move left, right, up, down) based on input parameters and updates related records.

methods.name: update_affected_order
methods.description: Updates the order position of an affected component after a move.

methods.name: get_affected_id
methods.description: Retrieves the ID of the component affected by a move based on parent ID and order positions.

methods.name: check_wall
methods.description: Determines if a component can move in a specified direction without exceeding boundary limits.

methods.name: delete_adjust_order
methods.description: Adjusts the order of components after deletion to maintain sequence integrity.
